$purpose: Research papers bed for FRQNCY. Open-access peer-reviewed and primary-source documents that anchor the /research/ pillar. Citations the network actually leans on.
$id_prefix: pp- (papers) to avoid collision with p- (people), pl- (places).

$collections.the-field: Consciousness / intention / zero-point-field research cited in Lynne McTaggart's The Field (2001)
$collections.dispenza: Peer-reviewed papers from Dr Joe Dispenza's research team (drjoedispenza.com/research)
$collections.wikileaks: Landmark Wikileaks releases — primary-source documents that changed public understanding
$collections.emoto-water: Peer-reviewed water-crystal research by or with Masaru Emoto

$schema.title: Paper title (as it appears on the PDF / DOI page)
$schema.authors: Comma-separated first-last names ('Roger D. Nelson, Brenda J. Dunne, ...')
$schema.venue: Journal name + volume/issue, or 'Wikileaks release' for primary-source documents
$schema.collection: One of: the-field | dispenza | wikileaks | emoto-water
$schema.url: Open-access URL — PDF, arxiv, PMC, or canonical primary source
$schema.desc: One-sentence FRQNCY-voice summary of what the paper found or contains
$schema.appears_in: (optional) Array of topic/domain/pillar IDs where this paper should surface

papers.title: Long-Term Study of Heart Rate Variability Responses to Changes in the Solar and Geomagnetic Environment
papers.authors: Rollin McCraty, Mike Atkinson, Viktor Stolc, Abdullah A. Alabdulgader, Alfonsas Vainoras, Minvydas Ragulskis
papers.desc: Five months of HRV data across continents tracked Schumann resonances and solar wind — human autonomic rhythms quietly sync with the planet's magnetic field.

papers.title: Cardiac Coherence, Self-Regulation, Autonomic Stability, and Psychosocial Well-Being
papers.authors: Rollin McCraty, Maria A. Zayas
papers.desc: Open-access synthesis: heart-rhythm coherence training improves emotional regulation, resilience, and well-being across populations from clinicians to soldiers.

papers.title: Coherence: Bridging Personal, Social, and Global Health
papers.authors: Rollin McCraty, Doc Childre
papers.venue: Alternative Therapies in Health and Medicine, vol 16(4)
papers.desc: McCraty and Childre argue coherence is the same pattern at every scale — heart rhythm, family, organization, planet — and each level reinforces the next.

papers.title: The Coherent Heart: Heart-Brain Interactions, Psychophysiological Coherence, and the Emergence of System-Wide Order
papers.authors: Rollin McCraty, Mike Atkinson, Dana Tomasino, Raymond Trevor Bradley
papers.desc: HeartMath's monograph on coherence: a specific heart-rhythm pattern that shows up under appreciation and propagates outward through the whole physiology.

papers.title: Correlations of Random Binary Sequences with Pre-Stated Operator Intention: A Review of a 12-Year Program
papers.authors: Robert G. Jahn, Brenda J. Dunne, Roger D. Nelson, York H. Dobyns, G. J. Bradish
papers.venue: Explore: The Journal of Science and Healing, vol 3(3)
papers.desc: Twelve years, 100 operators, over 1,000 series — random binary outputs tilted in the direction operators intended, with cumulative deviations far past chance.

papers.title: The PEAR Proposition
papers.authors: Robert G. Jahn, Brenda J. Dunne
papers.desc: The Princeton PEAR lab's own summing-up: 28 years of evidence that human intention nudges physical systems, plus the theoretical scaffold they offered for why.

papers.title: Electrophysiological Evidence of Intuition: Part 1. The Surprising Role of the Heart
papers.authors: Rollin McCraty, Mike Atkinson, Raymond Trevor Bradley
papers.venue: Journal of Alternative and Complementary Medicine, vol 10(1)
papers.desc: Heart-rate deceleration showed up before randomized emotional images — the heart appeared to register the stimulus before the picture was even chosen.

papers.title: Electrophysiological Evidence of Intuition: Part 2. A System-Wide Process?
papers.authors: Rollin McCraty, Mike Atkinson, Raymond Trevor Bradley
papers.venue: Journal of Alternative and Complementary Medicine, vol 10(2)
papers.desc: Follow-up: brain and heart both pre-respond to emotional stimuli, with the heart shifting first — a single system that anticipates rather than two organs reacting.

papers.title: Toward General Experimentation and Discovery in Conditioned Laboratory Spaces: Part I. Experimental pH Change Findings at Some Remote Sites
papers.authors: William A. Tiller, Walter E. Dibble Jr., Robert Nunley, C. Norman Shealy
papers.venue: Journal of Alternative and Complementary Medicine, vol 10(1)
papers.desc: Leave an intention-imprinted device in a room for three months and the room itself starts shifting water pH — a 'conditioned space' that holds the signal after the device is gone.

papers.title: Properties of Biophotons and Their Theoretical Implications
papers.authors: Fritz-Albert Popp
papers.venue: Indian Journal of Experimental Biology, vol 41(5)
papers.desc: Popp's synthesis on biophotons: every living cell emits a faint coherent light, and the coherence — not the brightness — is what carries the information.

papers.title: Correlations of Continuous Random Data with Major World Events
papers.authors: Roger D. Nelson, Dean I. Radin, Richard Shoup, Peter A. Bancel
papers.desc: A worldwide network of random number generators went non-random around 9/11 and other major events — small effects, but pre-registered and statistically real.

papers.title: Can an aspect of consciousness be imprinted into an electronic device?
papers.authors: William A. Tiller, Walter E. Dibble Jr., Michael J. Kohane
papers.venue: Integrative Physiological and Behavioral Science, vol 35(2)
papers.desc: Four meditators imprinted an electronic device with a single intention; placed 2,000 miles away, it shifted purified water's pH by a full unit — outside any chemical mechanism.

papers.title: Electronic Device-Mediated pH Changes in Water
papers.authors: Walter E. Dibble Jr., William A. Tiller
papers.desc: Bottled water with an intention-imprinted device nearby shifted pH up by a programmed amount; with an unimprinted identical device, nothing moved.

papers.title: Information Transmission Under Conditions of Sensory Shielding
papers.authors: Russell Targ, Harold E. Puthoff
papers.desc: SRI's foundational remote-viewing paper in Nature: subjects described hidden geographic targets under double-blind conditions, with hits the authors say exceed chance.

papers.title: Evidence of a Primary Perception in Plant Life
papers.authors: Cleve Backster
papers.desc: Backster's original paper: galvanometers on philodendron leaves jumped when he merely thought about burning them — the start of plant-perception research.

papers.title: Neural and Molecular Changes During a Mind-Body Reconceptualization, Meditation, and Open Label Placebo Healing Intervention
papers.authors: Hemal H. Patel, Joe Dispenza, et al.
papers.desc: Seven days of meditation quieted the default mode network like a psychedelic, raised endogenous opioids, and shifted gene-expression markers — measured with fMRI and blood draws.

papers.title: The Biological Dimensions of Transcendent States: A Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.authors: Dawson Church, Amy Yang, Jeffrey L. Fannin, Katharina Blickheuser
papers.desc: Workshop attendees who reported a transcendent state showed measurable shifts in heart-rate variability, EEG coherence, and gamma — biology tracking the inner report.

papers.title: Large Effects of Brief Meditation Intervention on EEG Spectra in Meditation Novices
papers.authors: Peta Stapleton, Joe Dispenza, Sarah McGill, Daniel Sabot, Madison Peach, Daniel Raynor
papers.desc: 223 first-time meditators in a 3-day workshop crossed into coherent theta-band patterns up to ten standard deviations outside the normal range, mostly inside the first minute.

papers.title: Long-Term Meditators Self-Induce High-Amplitude Gamma Synchrony During Mental Practice
papers.authors: Antoine Lutz, Lawrence L. Greischar, Nancy B. Rawlings, Matthieu Ricard, Richard J. Davidson
papers.desc: Tibetan monks with 10,000+ hours of practice produced gamma synchrony far above novice controls — and held it at baseline, suggesting trained states become traits.

papers.title: Vault 7: CIA Hacking Tools Revealed
papers.authors: WikiLeaks
papers.desc: 8,761 documents on the CIA's cyber arsenal — zero-days, malware, vehicle exploits, smart-TV bugs, the agency's own code library, released March 2017.

papers.title: Vault 7: Projects
papers.authors: WikiLeaks
papers.desc: The Vault 7 project-by-project index — Weeping Angel (Samsung TVs), Marble (attribution-obfuscation), Grasshopper (Windows implants) — each its own technical packet.

papers.title: DNC Email Database
papers.authors: WikiLeaks
papers.desc: 19,252 emails from seven Democratic National Committee officials — released 22 July 2016, exposing internal coordination during the Clinton-Sanders primary.

papers.title: Hillary Clinton Email Archive
papers.authors: WikiLeaks
papers.desc: 30,322 emails from Clinton's private State Department server, 2010-2014 — released as a searchable archive in March 2016.

papers.title: The Podesta Emails
papers.authors: WikiLeaks
papers.desc: 50,000+ emails from Clinton campaign chair John Podesta — released in 36 daily tranches starting October 2016, plus Wall Street speech transcripts.

papers.title: The Saudi Cables
papers.authors: WikiLeaks
papers.desc: Over half a million cables from the Saudi Foreign Ministry — released June 2015, the largest leak ever from any Arab government.

papers.title: NSA Documents Released to the Public Since June 2013
papers.authors: ACLU (compiled archive)
papers.desc: ACLU's catalog of every Snowden-disclosed and FOIA-released NSA document, organized by program — the librarian's index to the surveillance disclosures.

papers.title: NSA Primary Sources (Snowden Archive)
papers.authors: Edward Snowden (compiled by Electronic Frontier Foundation)
papers.desc: The EFF's running index of the original Snowden documents — PRISM slides, Boundless Informant maps, Bullrun crypto-attack programs, indexed and linkable.

papers.title: Public Library of US Diplomacy (PlusD)
papers.authors: WikiLeaks
papers.desc: WikiLeaks' searchable archive of the full Cablegate corpus plus the 1.7m-cable Kissinger files — the diplomatic record made permanently queryable.

papers.title: Afghan War Diary, 2004-2010
papers.authors: WikiLeaks
papers.desc: 91,000+ classified field reports from the Afghanistan war — released 25 July 2010, the first dump of US military ground-truth at this scale.

papers.title: Cablegate: 251,287 US Embassy Diplomatic Cables
papers.authors: WikiLeaks
papers.desc: Quarter-million cables from 274 US embassies, 1966-2010 — released starting 28 November 2010, the first time the State Department's working memory leaked at full volume.

papers.title: Collateral Murder
papers.authors: WikiLeaks
papers.desc: The classified Apache gunsight video from Baghdad, 12 July 2007 — released 5 April 2010, showing the killing of two Reuters journalists and the wounding of two children.

papers.title: Iraq War Logs
papers.authors: WikiLeaks
papers.desc: 391,832 US Army field reports covering Iraq from 2004 to 2009 — released 22 October 2010, documenting tens of thousands of previously unreported civilian deaths.

papers.title: Effects of Distant Intention on Water Crystal Formation: A Triple-Blind Replication
papers.authors: Dean Radin, Nancy Lund, Masaru Emoto, Takashige Kizu
papers.desc: 1,900 people in Austria and Germany targeted water in California; triple-blind judges still rated treated-water ice crystals as more beautiful than nearby controls (p=.03).

papers.title: Double-Blind Test of the Effects of Distant Intention on Water Crystal Formation
papers.authors: Dean Radin, Gail Hayssen, Masaru Emoto, Takashige Kizu
papers.venue: Explore: The Journal of Science and Healing, vol 2(5)
papers.desc: 2,000 people in Tokyo sent intention to water samples in a shielded room in California; ice crystals from the treated water were rated more beautiful by blind judges (p=.001).
